identity: Franklin Levering Cary Quadrangle (West), Purdue building abbreviation CQW, Purdue GIS building code 1315; address 1012 W Stadium Avenue.

sources.role: footprint, address, level-count and vertical extrusion attributes
sources.source_date: layer metadata last edit dates absent
sources.crs: EPSG:3857 (WKID 102100/latestWKID 3857), converted to EPSG:4326; projected to repository local approximation per modular/AGENTS.md
sources.method: Official feature geometry transformed with inverse spherical Mercator, then repository documented longitude/latitude-to-campus-metre approximation. Polygon area/perimeter fields are from service metadata, not recomputed from local approximation.
sources.uncertainty: Source service does not state vertical units for Extrution or a survey tolerance. Exact building wall-to-GIS relationship not surveyed; polygon shape is used as structural footprint.

sources.role: building history, construction materials and archival exterior photos
sources.provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections, Campus Facilities and Buildings Historic Database
sources.source_date: construction 1937-1938; source photo 181 dated 2004-06-24; photo 180 circa 1950s; photo 182 undated exterior photograph
sources.measurement_method: Record states West building built 1938, 59,036 sq ft, brick, architect Scholer Corporation; photos 181/182 interpreted for entrance massing, twin towers, oriel, arched entry, flat/parapet roofline, window rhythm.
sources.uncertainty: Archived photographs establish qualitative facade character but do not supply dimensions. Photo 181 metadata explicitly dates 2004; date for 182 unavailable.
